businesses.business: custom medical device and engineered component manufacturing

offering_description.value: UFP Technologies designs and manufactures single-use medical devices, device components and sterile packaging for medical technology companies. It also makes engineered components for automotive, aerospace, defense and industrial manufacturers. It converts foams, films and plastics into finished products and assemblies built to customer specifications.

primary_products.value: single-use medical devices and components; surgical drapes; sterile barrier packaging; orthopedic soft goods; engineered foam and plastic components

primary_services.value: product design and engineering; prototyping; contract manufacturing; cleanroom assembly and packaging

customer_segment.value: B2B: Medical device manufacturers and automotive, aerospace, defense and industrial manufacturers

end_markets.value: medical devices; automotive; aerospace and defense; industrial manufacturing

revenue_model.value: product sales: Custom medical devices, packaging and engineered components supplied to manufacturers; project or contract: Contract production and assembly to customer specifications

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Converts foams, films and plastics into finished devices and packaging for medical technology companies; component supplier: Converts foams and plastics into components for medical, automotive, aerospace, defense and industrial manufacturers; service provider: Turns customer specifications into prototypes and production-ready designs for equipment and device manufacturers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; component supplier; service provider

geography_served.value: global: United States, Mexico, Dominican Republic, Costa Rica and Ireland

specialization.value: related lines: Medical devices, sterile packaging and industrial components share custom materials conversion and manufacturing capabilities

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Direct supply relationships with medical device companies and other equipment manufacturers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Finished medical device manufacturing is subject to FDA establishment registration and quality system requirements where applicable

notes: The relative scale of the nonmedical markets is uncertain.
